images.caption: Site of former Children's Palace Toy Store at Boardman Plaza in Boardman Township, Ohio. Photo taken in November 2013

brief: Long single-storey strip plaza of 1951 facing a big parking lot: a continuous flat-roofed row of stores under a deep fascia band, rose-tinted aggregate panels and glass storefronts with aluminium doors, one taller anchor at the end, several units now dark. Remodelled facades of the 1980s over the original brick.

facade.notes: Boardman Plaza (Boardman OH, 1951): a long single-storey strip of stores behind one continuous fascia band, a raised sign block for a discount anchor in the middle, mansard-roofed pads at both ends; a huge parking lot behind a grass berm on the arterial

why.note: the postwar community centre: an anchor in the middle of one long row, parking for all in front
